n8028a3d0ee.summary: Arvind Panagariya counters claims of a 'dead economy,' stating India is growing at 7% and remains open to trade despite some protectionist measures.
n8028a3d0ee.why: Growth rate and trade openness are key indicators of economic health and investor confidence in India’s market and policy environment.
